summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Hafnia Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release and proxy materials for its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled on May 26, 2026. The agenda includes routine items such as adoption of financial statements, re-election of directors, re-appointment of chairman, approval of director fees, and re-appointment of auditor. There are no transaction-specific terms, price, premium, or structural mechanics. No alternative event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is disclosed. This is a standard meeting notice with no special-situation triggers.
